title: What to expect from Plans and Pricing

question.author: member_025
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for plans and pricing?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: Business: 10 TB shared across the organization with team folders, roles, and SSO, at $14.99 per user per month. Enterprise: custom storage and contract terms. Plan changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle; upgrades apply immediately with prorated charges. CloudBox offers four plans. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
